name: JK to Inkou Kyoushi 5 ~Shakkin Shimai Hen~
original_name: JKと淫行教師5～借金姉妹編～
source:
The protagonist is a Japanese history teacher at a private school.  
One day, he gets a call from his uncle, who happens to be a loan shark.  
Apparently, the parents of two famously beautiful sisters—students at the school—have gone bankrupt.  
The uncle suggests sending the girls into the sex trade to pay off their massive debt. Hearing this, the protagonist hatches a plan.  

“I’ll take on that debt for you. But in exchange…”  

The thought of having those two sisters at his mercy makes him so excited he can barely contain himself.  
And so, the older sister agrees to offer her body to protect her younger sister… while the younger sister agrees to do the same to save her older sister…  

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ005396.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主角是私立学校的日本历史老师。
有一天，他接到叔叔的电话，他的叔叔恰好是一名高利贷者。
显然，学校里两个出名美丽的姐妹的父母已经破产了。
叔叔建议让女孩们从事性交易，以偿还巨额债务。听到这话，主角心里暗暗想出一个计划。

“我会替你承担这笔债务。但作为交换……”  

一想到要让那两个姐妹受他摆布，他就兴奋得几乎无法控制自己。
于是，姐姐同意用自己的身体来保护妹妹……而妹妹也同意用自己的身体来拯救姐姐……
